title: Launchd Job Plan
description: A plan describing an intended launchd job, checked before writing/loading the real .plist.

label.description: Reverse-DNS style unique job label, e.g. com.example.myapp.

programArgs.description: ProgramArguments argv. Element 0 should be an absolute path unless env.PATH is pinned.

runAtLoad.description: Whether the job starts immediately on bootstrap/login/boot, not just on-demand.

keepAlive.description: Bare boolean, or an object with SuccessfulExit/Crashed semantics.

throttleInterval.description: Minimum seconds launchd waits between respawns. 0/absent risks restart thrash.

stdoutPath.description: StandardOutPath. Must not resolve under /tmp or /private/tmp.

stderrPath.description: StandardErrorPath. Must not resolve under /tmp or /private/tmp.

env.description: EnvironmentVariables map. PATH matters most for absolute-path avoidance.

agentVsDaemon.description: agent = ~/Library/LaunchAgents (per-user, GUI session). daemon = /Library/LaunchDaemons (system-wide, no GUI).

requiresGuiSession.description: True if the program touches Aqua/notifications/keychain UI/menu bar — impossible for a LaunchDaemon.

runsAtSystemBoot.description: True if the job must run before any user logs in — impossible for a LaunchAgent.

hasExternalIntegrityCheck.description: True if a process/cron/doctor command separately verifies the supervisor label is still loaded (independent of KeepAlive).
